shots.note: Cellarius's Ptolemaic cosmos, the Earth at the centre (1660): 'conventional conceptions… taken for objective facts that everyone knows and no one questions'
a Jim Crow 'COLORED WAITING ROOM' sign, 1943: 'narrow-minded bigotry and blind prejudice can develop unopposed' (ends on the join)
Daumier, Le Ventre législatif (1834), smug legislators on their benches: 'That arrogance, that prejudice, that bias, and bigotry' (on the join after 'bigoted on the right… left… center')
a padlocked door, from the first 'closed mind' through 'you're not open' (covers the join)
Thomas Cole, The Course of Empire: Destruction (1836), held from 'the person, the nation, the world starts to degenerate' through 'locked into one way of conceiving things'
the Flammarion engraving, a traveller putting his head through the sky to see beyond it: 'what we need is something from the outside, some creativity from the outside' (covers the join)
a towering corporate headquarters seen from below (Post Tower, Bonn): 'let's talk about a corporation, knows that they're good, knows that they're the best' (covers the join)
grounded 737 MAX jets parked near Boeing Field, 2019: 'like Boeing, that's not good' (covers the join; hard cut to Apple on 'Apple')
an Apple Store with the Apple logo: 'If you look at Apple, frankly, they were so sure'
a row of iPhones that all look alike: 'with regard to design, with regard to manufacture… when's the last time you saw anything really innovative come out of Apple?' (covers the join)
crowds streaming into an Apple Store under the logo: 'everyone knows they're good, everyone knows they're beautiful, and no one questions it' (ends on the join)
a 1940s Camel advertisement: 'More doctors smoke Camels than any other cigarette': 'smoking was thought to be good for you'
the Surgeon General's warning on a US cigarette pack: 'these two attitudes have changed'
young people round a table, every one of them on a phone: 'conditioned and determined by your environment' (on the join, covers the next)
a phone full of social-media apps: 'what you see on Instagram… TikTok and X'

Earthrise, Apollo 8 (1968), the whole Earth seen from outside it: 'anybody who can get out of that and look more holistically can do better, because they can see more clearly' (covers the join, to the end)
